artworks.prompt: Real underwater photograph: a single moon jellyfish drifting in dark deep-blue water, translucent bell with four pale rings, fine trailing tentacles, soft light from above. No bubbles, no rays.
Real deep-sea photograph: a small anglerfish in the dark blue water, its lure glowing soft blue-white, natural dark body. No ground.
Real deep-sea photograph: a dumbo octopus swimming in dark blue water, pale pink-peach body with ear-like fins, softly lit from above. No ground.
